lines.text: The more Israel's fruit increased, the more altars he built, and the LORD will break down those altars.
The people say they have no king because they do not revere the LORD, and they make covenants with false oaths.
The calf of Beth-aven will be carried to Egypt as tribute to the great king.
Since the days of Gibeah Israel has sinned, and the LORD will place a yoke on Ephraim's fair neck.
Because Israel trusted in its mighty men, the roar of battle will rise and fortresses fall as Zimri devastated Beth-arbel.
